description:
ADN-ZB: Fascist Germany 1933-1945. On January 30, 1933, Reich President Paul von Hindenburg appoints Adolf Hitler as Reichskanzler. On February 1, the new Reichskanzler Hitler (in picture) addresses the German nation in a call of the Reichsregierung, broadcast over all German transmitters.
[Berlin.- Adolf Hitler in front of radio microphone in a radio speech]
